candidate_ideas.statement: On every geometric split balanced fibre, residual CE evaluation of W=W_4⊕W_5 fails at a degree-six divisor Γ if and only if O_C(Γ)≅L:=W_5⊗ω_C^{-1}.
With H^1(W)=0 (both summands have degree >2g-2), Serre duality identifies nonvanishing of H^0(ω_C⊗W^vee(Γ)) with failure of surjectivity of the evaluation map H^0(W)→W|Γ.
As closed substacks of Conf_6(C/B), the reduced CE evaluation-rank-failure locus equals the reduced Abel–Jacobi incidence: (Z_ev)_red=I_red.
The quotient of I_red by S_6 is the reduced-support open of the relative Abel–Jacobi fibre Sym_B^6(C)×_{Pic^6(C/B),[L]}B, and the ordering map is a finite étale S_6-torsor onto that open.

Let B be a finite-type complex base carrying a smooth family of genus-6 tetragonal covers with an actual balanced CE splitting F=O(4)⊕O(5). Put W_f=(O_{P(E^vee)}(2)⊗γ^*O(-f))|_C and L=W_5⊗ω_{C/B}^{-1}. On Conf_6(C/B), with Z_ev the CE evaluation-rank-failure locus and I the Abel–Jacobi incidence O_C(p_1+⋯+p_6)≅L, one has (Z_ev)_red=I_red; I_red/S_6 is the reduced-support open of the relative AJ fibre with finite étale S_6 ordering torsor; every geometric fibre of the full AJ fibre is nonempty (without asserting reduced-support nonemptiness).
The evaluation-failure locus Z is nonempty on the balanced six-point geometry.

established_facts.evidence: C66-001-v3 primary locator SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6 (degree/Serre-duality calculation)
established_facts.statement: For the balanced Casnati–Ekedahl summands W=W_{f1}⊕W_{f2} with W_{fi}=(O_{P(E^vee)}(2)⊗γ^*O(-fi))|_C, the fibrewise residual obstruction decomposes as H^0(C,ω_C⊗W^vee(Γ))=⊕_i H^0(C,ω_C⊗W_{fi}^vee(Γ)), and deg(W_{fi}|_C)=4g+12-4fi.

established_facts.evidence: C66-001-v3 Canonical geometric bottleneck: CE line-bundle convention and balanced tetragonal splitting
established_facts.statement: Packet CE line-bundle convention: W_5:=(O_{P(E^vee)}(2)⊗γ^*O_{P1}(-5))|_C is the f_2=5 summand of (O(2)⊗γ^*F^vee)|_C, not the O_{P1}(5) summand of the balanced splitting F=O_{P1}(4)⊕O_{P1}(5).

established_facts.evidence: Direct arithmetic from deg(W_f)=4g+12-4f, deg(ω_C)=2g-2, and n=deg Γ=6
established_facts.statement: At g=6 one has deg(W_4)=20 and deg(W_5)=16; for deg Γ=6, deg(ω_C⊗W_4^vee(Γ))=10-20+6=-4 and deg(ω_C⊗W_5^vee(Γ))=10-16+6=0.

established_facts.evidence: Riemann–Roch arithmetic deg(L)=6 and χ(L)=6-6+1=1 imply h^0(L)≥χ(L)=1
established_facts.statement: For L=W_5⊗ω_C^{-1} one has deg(L)=16-10=6; on a smooth genus-6 curve χ(L)=deg(L)-g+1=1, hence h^0(L)=1+h^1(L)≥1 and the full Abel–Jacobi fibre in Sym^6 is nonempty.

established_facts.statement: For d=3g-3+n, the open input is W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{g,n}), identified by Poincaré duality with W_{2d-16}H^{2d-16}(M_{g,n})(d).

established_facts.statement: For the forgetful map M_{6,6}→M_{6,5}, the q=0 term H^{26}(M_{6,5};Q) vanishes because 26 exceeds vcd(M_{6,5})=25; with fibre cohomology only in degrees q=0,1, no Leray differential enters or leaves total degree 26.

established_facts.statement: For the RED-0001 residual list over Q, ordinary degree 2d-16 equals vcd for (3,12),(5,8),(6,6),(7,4),(8,2) and equals vcd-1 for (8,0),(8,1); it never exceeds vcd.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: χ(L)=1 only forces h^0(L)≥1 for the full Sym^6 Abel–Jacobi fibre; the unique effective divisor of L may be non-reduced (e.g. 6p), in which case the reduced-support open and the Conf_6 incidence are empty.
invalid_steps.statement: Conclude that the reduced-support open of the Abel–Jacobi fibre of L, or the ordered Conf_6 incidence Z_ev, is nonempty on every geometric genus-6 fibre from Riemann–Roch χ(L)=1 alone.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Identical geometric points over a finite-type base determine only equality of underlying reduced substacks; nilpotent structure and Fitting/determinantal ideals remain unconstrained.
